Rule: Invite the people who do the work, not only their managers
Why: Managers know the intended process; clerks know the real one

Rule: Walk through a real case, start to finish
Why: Real cases reveal workarounds; abstract discussions reveal opinions
Arguing about boxes and arrows slows the room down

Rule: Record pain points where they happen
Why: They become the Pain point attribute and, later, hypotheses for process mining
Two hours per level 3 process is enough; a second session for exceptions is better than a four-hour first one

Rule: Show the model back within a week
Why: People correct a drawing far more easily than they describe a process
